hero.title: Generate Product Images, Scene Photos & Detail Pages in One Place
hero.description: FlashLoom empowers brands and merchants to produce high-quality product visuals in minutes through intelligent generation and editing capabilities.

features.title: Features
features.description: Cover the entire product content generation workflow, making visual creation faster, more stable, and more commercially effective.

productImage.title: Product Image Generation
productImage.description: Input product information to quickly generate main images, selling point images, and detail page images, covering the complete e-commerce asset pipeline.

sceneImage.title: Scene Image Generation
sceneImage.description: Support human models, pet models, partial inpainting, and background replacement to easily create high-quality marketing visuals.

collaboration.title: Efficient Collaboration
collaboration.description: Unified asset management and version control, supporting rapid team iteration and improving product launch efficiency.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Flexible plans with pay-as-you-go and enterprise customization options. Scale freely based on team size and image generation needs.

generator.title: Product Image Generator
generator.description: Initial version supports main product image generation: fill in product information, select e-commerce platform and visual style, call Gemini image generation model on Vertex AI to return preview images.

form.title: Product Image Generator v1
